name: After § 88
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 88a. Stresses the impact that climate change may have on the tourism sector; reiterates that the tourism sector, as a vulnerable sector that is economically very important for some regions, may develop sustainable, environmentally responsible and low-carbon tourism practices, in the light of differing national circumstances;
